purpose: where the judge is wrong by land lead, hand, Dandan and life, on Hard self-play (no skill gap)
outcome: 120 games, 3536 positions: card lead underpriced most (3+ more cards in hand: judge 57%, won 67%; 3+ fewer: 37% vs 27%); land lead less (1-2 more: +6 to +7 points; 3+: +3); land lead 2+ with their Dandan at life 9+: 56% vs 66%; their Dandan at life 5-12: judge 8 points too gloomy
